latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Generator Ki Free.

- Instantly generate a 30-second video from your description, text, or images without complex video editing.
- Upload MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG files up to 200MB; AI handles the rest, delivering ready-to-share video in 1–2 minutes.
- Anonymous users are automatically granted free starter credits (no signup needed).
- Multiple commands supported: video creation, export, upload, check credits, and view status.
- Includes detailed session management, error handling, and support for common video and audio formats.
